map.弹性解（对照）：δ_el = w·L⁴ ÷ (8·E·I)（×1000 化 mm: Elastic solution (reference): δ_el = w·L⁴ ÷ (8·E·I) (×1000 to mm), circular I = π·d⁴ ÷ 64 (m⁴). RC long-term stiffness (GB 50010-2010, shown side by side with the elastic solution): M_q = (w_q/1000)·L²/2; first check M_q ≤ M_cr = f_tk·W_0 per 7.1.1 (W_0 = b·h²/6, kN·m) → if uncracked, B_s = E_c·I_0 and ψ is not applicable; if cracked, σ_s = M_q/(0.87·h₀·A_s), ψ = 1.1 − 0.65·f_tk/(ρ_te·σ_s) (clamped to 0.2–1.0), B_s = E_s·A_s·h₀²/[1.15ψ + 0.2 + 6α_E·ρ], θ = 2.0 − 0.4·min(1, ρ′/ρ) (7.2.5-1), B = B_s/θ (7.2.2-2), δ_lt = (1/4)·M_q·L²/B. Validation: w, L, E and d must be non-empty. Criterion: no fixed grading—the elastic deflection is proportional to the load and the fourth power of the beam length and inversely proportional to the fourth power of the diameter; the RC deflection follows the quasi-permanent combination and long-term stiffness.
